annotation.title_clean: MBTI를 활용한 융합형 교양교과목 연구－의사소통 능력, 협력적 자기조절, 인공지능 윤리의식의 변화를 중심으로
annotation.title_en: MBTI Personality Type-Based AI Robot Ethics Curriculum Application and Effectiveness Analysis
annotation.summary_en: Pre-post study of 64 Korean university students in a liberal arts course combining MBTI personality types and AI robot ethics. Communication skills, collaborative self-regulation and AI ethics awareness rose significantly, most in anti-discrimination. Findings support ethics education, though the study is limited by a small sample and low scale reliability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Course raised communication skills, especially information gathering.
Collaborative self-regulation improved in cognitive, behavioural and motivational domains.
AI ethics awareness improved most in anti-discrimination; robot rights and reliability also rose.
No significant change in responsibility, transparency and employment ethics items.
Limitations: single-university sample, self-report, low reliability of the AI ethics scale.
